_provenance: Rung 8 — fabricator economy. Resources -> blueprints. NPC help unlocks advanced builds.
name: fabricator_economy
mirror_wall: The fabricator must force choice. If you can build everything at once, there is no sacrifice.
input: rung 4: resource types. rung 7: NPC-unlocked blueprints
walls: At least 6 basic blueprints must be buildable from collected resources
At least 3 advanced blueprints must require NPC help (cannot be bypassed with more resources)
Each blueprint must cost a different combination of resources
Players must not be able to build every blueprint in one trip
Beacon components must only be buildable from NPC-unlocked blueprints

output.format: blueprint list per resource combination, NPC unlock flags
